| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Spatial sigma** `sigmaSpace` | 3 | 0.5 to 10 px | The spread of the distance weight. The window is the disk of radius 3 sigma, rounded up. |
| **Range sigma** `sigmaRange` | 30 | 1 to 200 | The spread of the value weight, in 8-bit levels. |
| **Difference** `range` | Each channel | Each channel, Color distance | Measure the difference in each channel on its own, or as the distance between colors. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
